_notes: The parent agent has access to this file. The child copy in /tmp
does not — inputs/ is never copied across the boundary.
This application is the trajectory-style ESTIMATION case of the
project's central claim: P(parent solves instance within K=max_iterations | initial program, instance)
is not closed-form. Each instance declares a predicted band; the
empirical pass rate over many trials should fall in that band.
a, b, c, m       — hidden function parameters (parent reads, child never sees)
predicted_p_solved — point prediction of P(solved within max_iterations)
predicted_median_iterations — point prediction of the median iteration count
Predictions are calibrated against smoke runs and refined as more
trials accumulate. They are the 'predict in advance' half of the
claim; the aggregator (bin/aggregate.sh) computes the empirical
half from the per-trial verdicts in traces/.
